policies.label: Air entry only: visa-free
policies.n: Incoming air entry only, valid ordinary passports and short tourism. Land and sea entry are not established by this evidence; crew, airside transit, employment and residence are excluded. No third-country visa or residence status is assumed. Explicit ordinary-passport exemptions for Mali, Niger, Morocco, Tunisia and Saint Kitts and Nevis. Valid passport. No numeric ordinary-tourist duration is stated; the separate CEN-SAD 30-day period is diplomatic/service-only. Apply only to incoming air passengers on this evidence. The governing pages are dated 2 October 2025 (AMDT 10/25) and individually retained in the full AMDT 10/26 register effective 1 October 2026; the January 2026 HTML title is not a visa enactment date.

policies.label: Air entry only: prior eVisa
policies.n: Incoming air entry only, valid ordinary passports and short tourism. Land and sea entry are not established by this evidence; crew, airside transit, employment and residence are excluded. No third-country visa or residence status is assumed. Visa required under the express entry default, after excluding the full ordinary-passport AIP exemption schedule, independently supported UAE waiver and unresolved newer-agreement/document/restriction cases. Apply through Visa Burkina before travel; obtain electronic approval before boarding. Source supports electronic issuance but not guaranteed approval or a uniform authorized stay. Air-entry scope only. Review: Rwanda is also excluded because its immigration authority publishes an explicit ordinary-passport exemption that conflicts with this residual rule. The retained 156 cases are scoped default proposals after known exclusions, not certification of a universally complete live exemption register. The governing pages are dated 2 October 2025 (AMDT 10/25) and individually retained in the full AMDT 10/26 register effective 1 October 2026; the January 2026 HTML title is not a visa enactment date.

policies.label: Air entry only: visa-free
policies.n: Incoming air entry only, valid ordinary passports and short tourism. Land and sea entry are not established by this evidence; crew, airside transit, employment and residence are excluded. No third-country visa or residence status is assumed. Named incoming-passenger exemptions in the CAR authorities’ still-published permanent AIC 17/A/22FC. The annex is unqualified by diplomatic/service passport class; ordinary passports are within its nationality statement. No waiver stay is specified. Restrict this proposal to air entry and valid ordinary passports. No expired-passport entitlement or CEMAC-wide extrapolation. The separate less-than-one-month exceptional visa provision is not the waiver duration. Re-read both actual PDF pages: ten names total, nine retained because US remains held. Current Rwanda immigration additionally corroborates RW ordinary passport. No unnamed origin receives a requirement from the annex omission. AIC 17/A/22FC is dated 25 March 2022 and remains listed PERM in the current October 2026 AIC index. Its continuing specific entry provisions, not the old generic GEN page or package date alone, support this scoped record.
